required_before_seal: Make project_record_id explicitly nullable only for aggregate FAC claims; add project_record_ids or a per-locus owner map so multi-project unions remain unambiguous.
Aggregate result claims must bind derived_from_claim_ids for every contributing candidate-disposition claim and a deterministic result rule, not loci alone.
Add a mechanical coverage ledger from each claim-bearing source field to atom IDs; require every normalized source assertion covered exactly once, with zero gaps and no unintended duplication.

Define text_sha256 as SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 claim text. Define binding_sha256 over a domain-separated JCS object that excludes binding_sha256 itself and includes claim_id, owner, kind, text_sha256, context, source field/ordinal, derived_from_claim_ids and ordered expanded locus IDs.
Ensure the manifest binds schema/version, input hashes, array names, counts and JCS hashes; keep storage hash, JCS hashes and legacy custom hashes distinctly named.

legacy_hash_check.condition: Valid only if the legacy FAC tuple changes solely by correcting its 64-character source link and claims remain additive outside that tuple.

remaining_gate: Different independent exact-hash review; no formal acceptance or generator readiness yet.
